title: Grid row menu: hide Delete on a master-detail line whose master is held (lockSource: 'master'), now that the lock reads say which kind of lock it is
body:
repo:objectstack#4 · os-justin · session_01QSeKYmRepQK9DkZeU7F53D

Filing gate: ① a product defect with a named location · Source: fleet (the consumer half of #37151 route A, left to seat repo:objectstack#4 under #36911; filed by zone a4-U at the seat's request)

## What happens

PR #37128 (#36911) makes plugin-grid's shared row menu read the batch approval-lock door. A row the read answers as locked offers no Edit, and Delete stays, because the server accepts the delete of a record held by its own approval and cancels the request (#13568).

A master-detail line whose master is held is different. The detail-row lock hook refuses insert, update and delete (`bindDetailRowLockHook` in `packages/plugins/plugin-approvals/src/lifecycle-hooks.ts`). On such a line the menu still offers a Delete the server then refuses with `RECORD_LOCKED`.

PR #37191 (#37151, route A) merged at 2026-11-25T05:21Z. Both lock doors now answer `{ locked: true, lockSource: 'record' | 'master' }` (master wins when both hold), `{ locked: false }` or `null`, and the client types carry it. That PR left `ui/packages/plugin-grid/**` untouched and named this half as seat 4's, under #36911.

reach: read from code. Reachable from any list page or related list over the lines of an expense report or order under approval (showcase expense lines). Not measured in a browser.

## Expected

The row menu, and the list page's single-row selection bar that reads the same `rowActionMenuProps`, hides Delete on a row whose lock answer is `lockSource: 'master'`.

A row held by its own approval (`lockSource: 'record'`) keeps Delete, as today. A 501, a `null` entry, or a failed or unasked read leaves the menu as it was.

## Acceptance

- Pins, in the existing harness `rowMenuApprovalLock-36911.test.tsx`:
  - a `master`-held row offers neither Edit nor Delete;
  - a `record`-held sibling offers no Edit and keeps Delete;
  - the list-page selection bar does the same;
  - the 501, `null` and failed-read controls stay green.
- Ablate once (drop the `master` arm): the master pin goes red.
- Update the column docblock and the `ObjectGrid.tsx` hook comment, which since #37128 say a master-held line "keeps Edit and Delete in this menu, and is refused by the server".
- One `patch` changeset for `@object-ui/plugin-grid`.

Grading: area:ux · Bug · moderate (an offered action the server refuses; no data written wrong) · reach named (the grid row menu via #37128, showcase expense lines) · evidence read → p2; size S. Triage to confirm.

Business reason: anyone working the lines of an expense report or order under approval in a list page is offered a Delete the server then refuses. The batch lock door exists so a list can know first.

Reader: zone a4-U (seat repo:objectstack#4), which claims it at its next free slot.

Dedupe: `lockSource` (open) → #37195, the record page composite lock (a different door). `hide Delete master` and `row menu master-held` → no open card for the grid half. #37151 lists it as its consumer item, and PR #37191 hands it to seat 4 under #36911.
